articles.title: zodify added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new Python library, 'zodify,' offers Zod-inspired dictionary validation with zero dependencies and a single-file design. This tool aims to simplify data validation for developers. Currently in its alpha phase, zodify’s API is subject to change, and community feedback is encouraged to help shape its future development. This open-source initiative highlights ongoing advancements in software development tools.

articles.title: The Russians Turning to Google Maps In Search of Missing Soldiers
articles.summary: Google Maps significantly differs from traditional paper maps by enabling collective user annotation. Unlike private notes on a physical map, Google Maps allows individuals to contribute collaboratively, thereby fostering a new kind of shared geographical knowledge. This collective intelligence transforms how information is accessed and built upon, creating a dynamic, community-driven platform for common understanding.

articles.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk – Seek & Listen: Live at the Penthouse (2025)
articles.summary: In November 2025, Resonance Records, led by producers Zev Feldman and George Klabin, released two previously unissued live recordings by the legendary Rahsaan Roland Kirk. One prominent release is "Seek & Listen: Live at the Penthouse." This initiative brings rare historical performances to fans, enriching the iconic musician's legacy and demonstrating continued efforts in music preservation and distribution.

articles.title: HC dismisses Save India Foundation’s PIL challenging Waqf notification 46 years later, calls it ‘habitual’ petitioner
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court dismissed a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) by the Save India Foundation, challenging a 46-year-old Delhi Waqf Board notification. The PIL contested the declaration of certain properties, but the court upheld the historical notification. This ruling underscores the judiciary's role in addressing long-standing administrative and property-related disputes within national legal frameworks, reinforcing the existing status of the properties.

articles.title: Srinagar civil enclave to be developed further at the cost of ₹1,677 cr
articles.summary: A new civil enclave is being developed at Srinagar International Airport in the Kashmir Valley, costing an estimated ₹1,677 crore. This significant project aims to substantially strengthen aviation infrastructure in the region, enhancing connectivity and boosting civilian travel and logistics within Jammu and Kashmir, thereby supporting regional growth and accessibility.

articles.title: Azim Premji University says 20 people vandalised campus, caused ruckus; probe ordered
articles.summary: Azim Premji University in Bengaluru addressed a Monday campus ruckus where individuals shouted slogans, vandalized property, and assaulted people. The university condemned these disruptive acts, emphasizing the breach of peace and safety. It clarified the situation, reassuring the community on maintaining a secure academic environment.
